title: Computational Neuroscience of Language Processing in the Human Brain
official: Computational Neuroscience of Language Processing in the Human Brain
summary: Language is a signature human cognitive skill, but the precise computations that support language understanding remain unknown. This study aims to combine high-quality human neural data obtained through intracranial recordings with advances in computational modeling of human cognition to shed light on the construction and understanding of speech.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical indications to proceed with intracranial monitoring involving the left cerebral hemisphere, as determined by a multidisciplinary epilepsy surgery team
* the ability to comply with test directions and provide informed consent
* between ages 18 - 85

Exclusion Criteria:

* inability to understand or perform the task outlined in the protocol, or who are unwilling or unable to participate
